title: A guard diff's PR run runs the Windows guard shards
why: Coordinator, 13:52 CST Nov 7: main red at 174b005c1, Windows guard shard 2.
note: Cause of main-red-conflict-markers-windows: the PR run of #1402 did not run the Windows guard shards, so the red showed only on main. Related, 23:23 CST Nov 7: step windows-tests-for-touched-files widens the Windows run to every test file a lane touches, building on this step's trigger (#1543).
